name: Breitspur
tagline: The versions that should have existed.
description: Breitspur is a design studio for German cars.  We define the versions the factories never built.

manifesto.lead: Every great car had a sharper version that never left the design studio.  Breitspur defines those cars.
manifesto.body: Every concept starts from the factory's own design language and goes one step further than the factory dared, to the car it should have been.

founder.quote: Stance is the first thing you feel about a car.  Get it wrong and nothing else you do matters.
founder.name: Nick DiLoreto
founder.bio: Nick DiLoreto trained as a car designer and started his career at Volvo.  He now leads industrial design for a major consumer hardware brand.  Breitspur is where he designs cars again.

services.title: Concept render
services.body: Send photos of your car and tell us about it.  We work out what it should have been, the stance, wheels and color, and deliver it as one finished hero render.

services.title: Full commission

process.title: Tell us the car
process.body: Tell us your car, size and finish, and we take it from there.

process.title: Fitment
process.body: You send your measurements, brakes and stance goals, and we review them with you before anything is cut.  The final fitment call stays with you and your installer.

process.title: Machined for your car
process.body: Your set is machined, finished and shipped.

bespoke.label: MADE FOR ONE CAR
bespoke.lead: Machined for one car at a time.
bespoke.body: Every set is made to order.  Each center starts as a forged 7075-T6 blank and is machined to the fitment of the car it is going on.

items.title: Brake clearance

heroDetails.title: Pricing
heroDetails.body: Priced per wheel by size and finish, from {price} for a set of four.  You get a price for your exact set before you commit to anything.

heroDetails.title: How ordering works
heroDetails.body: Inquire with your car.  We work out the size and fitment with you, then send a specification and a price.  Once you approve it, your set is machined, assembled and shipped.  Orders open soon, and everyone who inquires hears about build slots and lead times first.

heroDetails.title: Shipping
heroDetails.body: Every set ships assembled and finished, packed to protect the lip, to you or straight to your installer.  Shipping cost and timing are confirmed with your specification.

privacy.intro: Breitspur is a small, independent studio.  We collect as little as we can, we never sell it, and you can ask us to delete it at any time.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: Inquiries: if you send the inquiry form, we keep your name, email address, your car and your message.  Netlify, our web host, receives and stores the form for us.

Shop inquiries: if you inquire about a product or sign up for shop updates, we keep your name, email address, your car and the answers you chose, such as size, finish and budget.  Netlify stores these for us too.
Server logs: like any web host, Netlify records basic request data such as IP address, browser type and the pages requested.  We use it only to keep the site running and secure.
We do not run analytics, ad trackers or user accounts, and we set no cookies of our own.

sections.heading: How we use it
body: We use your details to reply to your inquiry and, if we work together, to deliver the project.  If you inquired about a product, we email you about that product only, and use the answers in aggregate to decide what to make.  We send studio news only if you ticked the box for it.  We never sell, rent or trade your details.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: Wherever you live, you can ask what we hold about you, have it corrected, or have it deleted.  Every product email has an unsubscribe link, or write to us through the inquiry form and we will act within 30 days.

sections.heading: Changes
body: If this policy changes, we will update the date at the top of this page.

home.intro: Breitspur means wide track.  Every great car starts with how it sits on its wheels, so every concept here debuts a wheel and the parts to build it.

pitch.title: What should your car have been?
pitch.body: Send us your car and we work out the version it should have been: stance, wheels, flares and color.  Concepts for private owners, shops and makers.

signup.title: Hear first.
signup.body: Wheels open soon and new concepts are on the way.  Leave your email and your car, and you hear first.

home.oneLiner: A design studio for German cars, with the wheels and parts to build them.

story: I was ten when I started counting down the days until I could drive.  My mother's father owned a body shop and spent his days bringing exotic cars back to life.  My father's father was an engineer who took everything apart to see how it worked.  My dad and I talked about cars constantly.

I trained as a car designer, started at Volvo, and still lead industrial design today.  Breitspur is where I design cars again, and it starts with the thing that matters most: stance.  If a car doesn't sit right, nothing else matters.

steps.title: Send the car
steps.body: Photos of your car from every side, and what you love and what you would change.

steps.title: Agree the direction
steps.body: Stance, wheels, flares and color are agreed with you before any rendering starts.

steps.title: Render and refine
steps.body: We render the concept and refine it with you until it is the car it should have been.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.body: Finished renders, and for a full commission, builder notes your shop can work from.
